perks.name: Collective Demolition
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

enhanced.name: Collective Demolition
enhanced.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of improved grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Mega Kill Clip
perks.description: Reloading after a final blow grants a period of increased damage. Additional final blows before reloading further increases the duration of the damage period.

enhanced.name: Mega Kill Clip
enhanced.description: Reloading after a final blow grants a longer period of increased damage. Additional final blows before reloading further increases the duration of the damage period.

perks.name: Killing Tally
perks.description: Kills increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded.

enhanced.name: Killing Tally
enhanced.description: Final blows increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded. Improves magazine size.

perks.name: Withering Gaze
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

enhanced.name: Withering Gaze
